questions.description: 用 global 实现计数器。
questions.code_template:
count = 0
def increment():
    global count
    count += 1

increment()
increment()
increment()
print(___)
questions.solution:
count = 0
def increment():
    global count
    count += 1

increment()
increment()
increment()
print(f"Count: {count}")

questions.description: 全局列表在函数内修改。
questions.code_template:
nums = [1, 2, 3]
def add_item(n):
    nums.append(n)

add_item(4)
add_item(5)
print(___)
questions.solution:
nums = [1, 2, 3]
def add_item(n):
    nums.append(n)

add_item(4)
add_item(5)
print(nums)

questions.description: 全局字典在函数内更新。
global 声明多个变量。
questions.code_template:
a = 1
b = 2
def swap():
    global a, b
    a, b = b, a

swap()
print(___, b)
questions.solution:
a = 1
b = 2
def swap():
    global a, b
    a, b = b, a

swap()
print(a, b)

    total = total + n

questions.description: 嵌套函数修改外层（nonlocal）。
questions.code_template:
def outer():
    x = 1
    def inner():
        nonlocal x
        x = 2
    inner()
    print('X:',___)

outer()
questions.solution:
def outer():
    x = 1
    def inner():
        nonlocal x
        x = 2
    inner()
    print('X:', x)

outer()

questions.description: nonlocal 实现内层计数。
questions.code_template:
def outer():
    count = 0
    def inner():
        nonlocal count
        count += 1
    inner()
    inner()
    print('Count:',___)

outer()
questions.solution:
def outer():
    count = 0
    def inner():
        nonlocal count
        count += 1
    inner()
    inner()
    print('Count:', count)

outer()

questions.description: 闭包多次调用保持状态。
questions.code_template:
def counter():
    count = 0
    def inc():
        nonlocal count
        count += 1
        return count
    return inc

c = counter()
print(c())
print(c())
print(___)
questions.solution:
def counter():
    count = 0
    def inc():
        nonlocal count
        count += 1
        return count
    return inc

c = counter()
print(c())
print(c())
print(c())
